messages:
Maya (Design): Quick thread on the token-usage heatmap in dark mode 12. Current palette looks vibrant but several adjacent buckets read the same for some folks during testing. Any quick wins?
Ethan (Eng-UI): Saw that. The red->purple ramp is pretty but fails deutan simulation. We could go to a two-hue sequential (deep teal -> warm amber) to preserve perceived ordering.
Sofia (PM): We only need users to perceive ordinal 'low/medium/high'. Exact color isn't critical. If we pair color with value labels on hover and an accessible legend that should cover most use cases.
Ravi (Eng-DataViz): Pattern fills are an option for accessibility, but they create visual noise at 8px cells. Alternative: add a thin inner stroke on the top 2 buckets and optional hatch for the single hottest bucket.
Lina (A11y): Recommend defaulting to a colorblind-safe ramp + an "Enhanced contrast" toggle. Also require keyboard-focusable legend items and aria-describedby on cells. Contrast: aim for 4.5:1 for text/labels, but cell colors can be lower if value is exposed via text/tooltip.
Maya (Design): Good call. For the legend copy: instead of "Hot/Cold" what about "Low \u2014 High usage" and make the legend interactive (click to isolate)?
Ethan (Eng-UI): Interactive legend sounds useful. I'll prototype a focus ring and role=button on items. Proposed color hexes for dark bg `#0b1220`: `#08323d, #1b6f6a, #6fc3a7, #ffd28a, #ff6b3d`. Quick sim looked promising.
Lina (A11y): Can you run that through a colorblind simulator and paste results? Also ensure hover text contrast meets 4.5:1.
Ravi (Eng-DataViz): Regarding patterned fills: what if we only enable them in the High-Contrast mode? That keeps default clean and gives redundancy for a11y users.
Sofia (PM): Documentation/copy: rename theme selector options to "Dark (balanced)" and "Dark (enhanced contrast)". Also add a one-line tooltip: "Enhanced contrast increases visibility for charts and code."
Maya (Design): On code panel: tokens are currently low-contrast on dark background. Proposed tokens: keyword `#92d8ff`, string `#ffd7a8`, number `#ffd36b`, comment `#6e7780`. Comments can be muted but focusable.
Ethan (Eng-UI): I'll validate those against `#0b1220`. If comments fall below contrast, we'll reveal full comment color on focus.
Lina (A11y): Also add `prefers-reduced-motion` handling for chart entrance animations and avoid hover-only information.
Ravi (Eng-DataViz): Tooltip shadows barely show on dark. Suggest: background `rgba(11,18,32,0.94)` with `box-shadow: 0 8px 24px rgba(0,0,0,0.6)` and 12px blur for separation.
Ethan (Eng-UI): I'll centralize as CSS vars for easy toggles: `--heat-1..5`, `--tooltip-bg`, `--focus-ring`. That will make the enhanced mode a single attribute switch on `body` for faster render.
theme-checker-bot: Running contrast and pattern checks for branch `feat/heatmap-contrast`. 3 tests queued.
Sofia (PM): Agreed next steps: Ethan to ship a dev preview of both palettes + enhanced mode, Lina will run an a11y checklist, Maya will update figma tokens and copy, Ravi will test performance with large grids. Target: staging preview by end of sprint.
Maya (Design): Thanks everyone 14. I'll add a short usability task for legend interpretation in next round.
Lina (A11y): Ping me when the preview is up, I'll run keyboard and screen reader passes. :white_check_mark:
